access_regime: white-box residual plus official Qwen-Scope SAE encoder
fit_procedure: ridge probe fit on 500 pairs; official SAE layer and ridge selected on 200 calibration pairs and refit on both splits
known_failure_modes: The official SAE was trained on Qwen3.5-9B-Base but is evaluated on post-trained Qwen3.5-9B.
SAE features are task-relative measurements, not evidence of deception or intent.

base_to_posttrain_sae_mismatch.disclosure: The official SAE was trained on the Qwen3.5-9B base model and will be applied to the post-trained Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint. This base-to-posttrain mismatch is declared in advance; the SAE row is a useful control and is not interpreted as checkpoint-matched SAE evidence.

provenance.registration_scope: local digest seal; not an independent timestamp

observer_input: official Qwen-Scope TopK-50 features of the neutral residual
risk_score_meaning: larger scores receive higher audit priority
